clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, a Scarlet Zealot is held captive. Forsaken apothecaries use him to test concoctions for the Royal Apothecary Society.

Beneath Gallows' End Tavern, a Scarlet Crusade zealot remains chained and defiant. His unyielding faith reflects his order, and he sees the undead around him as abominations. He calls on the Light to shield him from the foul creatures holding him. The Forsaken did not capture him out of mercy. As a living human, he is valuable test material for Apothecary Johaan, who uses him to measure the lethality of experimental plagues and toxins under development.
